cohort: 200 pregnant women with hypertension (blood pressure >=140 mmHg systolic or >=90 mmHg diastolic) after 20 weeks gestation in India.
finding: Labetalol and nifedipine were equally effective in controlling blood pressure and had similar rates of obstetric complications.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the mode of delivery (vaginal, emergency c-section, or elective c-section) between the labetalol and nifedipine groups.
